adapter_provenance.method: Independent dispositions and dimension rationales copied unchanged; source paths bound to evidence IDs

reliability.rationale: All saved predictions and primary metrics independently reproduce from source-verified inputs, including unfavorable alternatives. Persistence wins development and transfers to one held animal on author-processed pupil traces. Five dynamical extensions do not establish a mechanism; animal, recording session and cortical region are confounded, and processed pupil size is not neuronal activity.

mechanism.rationale: Computational agreement cannot identify a physical or causal mechanism. Persistence wins development and transfers to one held animal on author-processed pupil traces. Five dynamical extensions do not establish a mechanism; animal, recording session and cortical region are confounded, and processed pupil size is not neuronal activity.

novelty.rationale: This review checks computation and information access; targeted literature records are not independent priority adjudication.

significance.rationale: Reusable scoped comparison and preserved falsification evidence. Persistence wins development and transfers to one held animal on author-processed pupil traces. Five dynamical extensions do not establish a mechanism; animal, recording session and cortical region are confounded, and processed pupil size is not neuronal activity.

reproducibility.rationale: Native reconstruction, independent group-weighted metric reduction, frozen replay, row-order invariance and target-poisoning checks passed. Development validation identities were checked against recorded training membership.

impact.rationale: No deployed intervention, operational saving, clinical qualification or independently measured safety benefit is established.
